content:
<PLOT_SUMMARY>

Past: Govardhan (Vijay Devarakonda) is a family man. As a selfless character, he works in a business to provide for his family. He also faces trouble with his brother (who is a drunkard). After learning that his flight tickets weren't paid for, he resorts to Indu, who provides money for his family. He goes to a previous job offeror (Jagapathi Babu), requests to join the company and asks for a big advance.

However, it is revealed that Indu is actually the daughter of the head. When she is questioned about her unusual behavior, she tells a story about her past. However, he meets Indu when she moves into his ‘space’. Though annoyed, he continues on in the company, but demands everything Indu gets. That too, Indu and his family quickly become friends. Soon, they both fall in love.

However, when he finds her thesis on his family and him, he slaps her and vows to teach her a lesson. After revealing that she heard him that day, she leaves him. Heartbroken, Indu isolates herself from him. After falling in love again, she hears him talking to a lady negatively about Indu saying that she isn't the right person for him.

After a big incident, he reconciles with his brother after his mother reveals to Indu that his brother hated him because of Govardhan shaming him. He uses that advance to defy whatever Indu has written in her thesis.

Present: A woman named Indu (Mrunal Thakur) sadly sits in the middle of a ceremony. It is revealed that Indu is at that wedding. Present: Govardhan finds out Indu's true intentions of writing the thesis from her father and proceeds to stop her from a wedding, held for one person who got injured due to Govardhan and (according to the person's grandfather- a famous politician) would be the only thing to make him feel better. Govardhan defeats the politician's goons along with his mother, wins back Indu, and marries her at the end.
